# AMY Electric — Los Angeles Licensed Electrician

> C-10 #981578 · EVITP #4051604 · (818) 302-5614. Licensed residential and commercial electrician serving Greater Los Angeles since 2012.

## Contact

- Phone: (818) 302-5614
- Email: info@amyelectric.com
- Service Area: Greater Los Angeles, CA
- Hours: Mon–Fri 7 AM–5 PM, 24/7 Emergency

## Credentials

- California C-10 Electrical Contractor License #981578
- EVITP (Electric Vehicle Infrastructure Training Program) Certification #4051604
- Licensed, bonded, and insured
- Verified at CSLB: https://www.cslb.ca.gov/OnlineServices/CheckLicenseII/LicenseDetail.aspx?LicNum=981578

## Services

- [EV Charger Installation](/ev-charger-installation) — Level 2 EV charger install for Tesla, Rivian, and all EVs. EVITP-certified.
- [Hardwired vs Plug-In EV Charger](/ev-charger-hardwired-vs-plug-in) — Comparison guide for EV charger types.
- [Tesla Charger Installation](/tesla-charger-installation) — Tesla Wall Connector and NEMA 14-50 outlet installation.
- [Panel Upgrades](/panel-upgrade) — 100A to 200A electrical panel upgrades. LADWP-coordinated.
- [100A vs 200A Panel](/panel-100a-vs-200a) — Which amp service is right for your home.
- [Electrical Repair](/electrical-repair) — Troubleshooting, wiring repairs, and code corrections.
- [Commercial Electrical](/commercial-electrical) — Commercial tenant improvements, wiring, and maintenance.
- [Lighting Installation](/lighting-installation) — Interior and exterior lighting installation.
- [Whole Home Rewiring](/whole-home-rewiring) — Complete electrical rewiring for older homes.
- [Surge Protection](/surge-protection) — Whole-home surge protector installation.
- [Outlet & Switch Installation](/outlet-switch-installation) — New outlets, switches, and GFCI/AFCI upgrades.
- [Ceiling Fan Installation](/ceiling-fan-installation) — Ceiling fan install and replacement.
- [Smoke & CO Detector Installation](/smoke-co-detector-installation) — Hardwired smoke and carbon monoxide detectors.
- [Generator Transfer Switch](/generator-transfer-switch) — Manual and automatic transfer switch installation.
- [Dedicated Circuits](/dedicated-circuits) — Dedicated circuits for appliances and equipment.
- [Smart Home Electrical](/smart-home-electrical) — Smart switches, outlets, and home automation wiring.
- [Electrical Safety Inspections](/electrical-safety-inspections) — Home electrical safety inspections.
